notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.1.12 - Script: the Add Step / Edit Step dialog now fits short screens (for example 1366x768, or 1080p at 125-150% scaling): the step list turns one-line and the fields scroll, so OK / Cancel are always visible. The dialog is also wide enough that Wait Until's Compare choices are no longer squeezed. While a run is paused, the summary bar now always says Paused (it could switch back to Running).
